devdoc.details: Normalizes answers to 1e18 preciseUnits ("fiat per deposit token") with rounding-up. Raw config format: - abi.encode(address feed, bool invert) Normalized config format (packed bytes, length = 22): - [0..19]  feed (address, 20 bytes) - [20]     decimals (uint8) - [21]     invert flag (uint8; 0 = false, 1 = true)

getRate(bytes).details: Returns (false, 0, 0) on invalid oracle responses. Does not perform staleness checks.

validateConfig(bytes).details: Reverts if feed decimals exceed 18. Special-case: `feed == address(0)` is allowed and implies a constant 1.0 base rate (in preciseUnits). This is useful for USD when the deposit token is assumed to be USDC.

devdoc.title: ChainlinkOracleAdapter

getRate(bytes).notice: Returns the market rate in preciseUnits and the oracle `updatedAt`.

validateConfig(bytes).notice: Validates raw config and returns packed normalized config.
